purpose: Labelled (proposed change, stored decision) pairs for calibrating the retrieval floor that gates the agent editor hook. The hook asks one question - 'is this edit about something the team already decided' - so the pairs are shaped like that, not like search queries.
labelling_rule: related = the stored decision is one a reviewer would want to see before making this change, whether the change agrees with it or contradicts it. unrelated = seeing it would be noise. Hard negatives share a domain with their decision and differ in the PARAMETER decided, because a corpus of easy negatives makes any threshold look good.
provenance: Decision texts are paraphrases of real conventions in align-stack's own .claude/rules (pino over console.log, pnpm, tenant from the token, SQS visibility above the brain timeout) plus the two commits the install smoke seeds. Change texts are written as an agent's edit would read.

measured.note: Regenerate with ALIGN_CALIBRATE=1 npx vitest run src/__tests__/relatedness-calibration.test.ts. Scores are recorded so the calibration test needs no model download; the opt-in test recomputes them against the real model.
